comment: Hand-transcribed expected cgi-exec decisions from pinned cgi-io C and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: cgi-io main_exec requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded (strncmp 33) then session.access(sid, cgi-io, exec, read).
cgi-io supplies scope; this is not the uhttpd omit-scope /ubus path.
Missing or empty sessionid after a valid content-type is HTTP 403, not 400.
Invalid content-type is HTTP 400 Invalid form data (postdecode returns NULL).
luci-mod-network-config read grants cgi-io exec. Unauthenticated, luci-mod-system-config, luci-mod-system-flash, and luci-mod-status-realtime do not.
luci-mod-status-logs, luci-mod-status-firewall, and luci-app-package-manager also grant cgi-io exec at the pin; this slice does not staff those logins or invent those grants.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Emission is bounded to the cgi-io exec ACL gate. Do not emit cgi-backup, cgi-upload, cgi-download, dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, or a command file.exec.
This oracle does not parse_command, canonicalize argv0, lookup_executable, or fork execv.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no cgi-io exec
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: session_access false -> 403 Exec permission denied
do not invent an unauthenticated cgi-exec grant
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: !fields[1] -> 403 Exec permission denied
valid content-type with absent sessionid is not HTTP 400
cgi-io@31cb3c89 util.c postdecode: CONTENT_TYPE must start with application/x-www-form-urlencoded
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_exec: !post -> 400 Invalid form data

luci-mod-network-config still contributes cgi-io exec to the root session

do not treat a luci exec-method grant as cgi-exec

do not treat cgi-io backup or download as cgi-exec

do not invent a luci-mod-status-realtime cgi-exec grant
